description: Caveman Reasonix hooks. Reasonix uses Claude-style settings.json with a FLAT hook object schema: { event, match, command, description, timeout(ms), cwd }. timeout is in milliseconds (unlike Qoder/CodeBuddy which use seconds). match is anchored regex. NOTE: the commands below use ${REASONIX_PLUGIN_ROOT} only as a structural example. The actual installer (scripts/install-reasonix.js) writes absolute POSIX paths into ~/.reasonix/settings.json and does not use environment-variable placeholders.

SessionStart.description: Activate caveman mode and inject compressed-communication rules

UserPromptSubmit.description: Track caveman mode, handle /caveman commands, per-turn reinforcement

PreToolUse.description: Block dangerous operations (rm -rf, system file writes, etc.)

PostToolUse.description: Warn when a tool returns a large response

PreCompact.description: Inject caveman rules into compression guidance

Stop.description: Check caveman output quality and record session stats snapshot
